mandatory_legal_checks: DPDP Act 2023 S.8(2) — a Data Fiduciary may engage a Data Processor ONLY under a valid contract
DPDP Rules 2025 R.1 — phased commencement: R.1, 2, 17-21 from 14 Nov 2025; R.4 from 14 Nov 2026; R.3, 5-16, 22, 23 from 14 May 2027
DPDP Rules 2025 R.6 — minimum security safeguards, including retention of logs for one year and contractual flow-down
DPDP Rules 2025 R.7 — breach: intimate affected Data Principals without delay; preliminary intimation to the Board, detailed particulars within 72 hours
DPDP Act 2023 S.8(7) — erasure on withdrawal of consent or once the purpose is served
DPDP Act 2023 S.16 — the Central Government may restrict transfer to notified countries
Sectoral localisation (e.g. RBI payment system data) applies independently of the DPDP Act
